items.author: Affiverse Media
items.text: Working with Makeberry this 2025 has proved satisfying for Affiverse as the brand has grown immensely. The relationship with their team has been amazing. Makeberry is leaving its mark on the iGaming industry as they have shown to be more than just an agency

items.author: iGB Affiliate
items.text: Makeberry consistently delivers high-quality traffic and transparent reporting. Their team understands the iGaming market deeply and adapts campaigns based on real performance data instead of assumptions, which is something we genuinely value as a partner.

items.author: SBC Media
items.text: What stands out about Makeberry is the speed of execution and the quality of communication. Issues get resolved within hours, not days, and the team brings proactive ideas to the table. It feels like working with an in-house performance unit.
